creatureHabitatEnvelopes.anchorBehavior: Locks three survey legs on an expired invited line while the fourth targets the nearest occupied threshold.
creatureHabitatEnvelopes.sustenance: Unlawful crossings and obsolete witnessed invitation lines.
creatureHabitatEnvelopes.propagation: One new colony may bud only when an invitation expires without its physical line being retired.
creatureHabitatEnvelopes.cessation: Renew, revoke, or physically retire the line before the fourth leg lands; consumed lines become dead service trenches and cannot respawn.
creatureHabitatEnvelopes.questStateDelta: Colony and trench states serialize per perimeter segment.

creatureHabitatEnvelopes.anchorBehavior: Nests at the overlap of a measurable stress path, warning source, and empty sufficient-cause frame.
creatureHabitatEnvelopes.sustenance: Overlapping karst stress and repeated warnings.
creatureHabitatEnvelopes.propagation: A new Cantor can appear only when a persistent built cause creates a distinct future result debt.
creatureHabitatEnvelopes.cessation: A sufficient cause completes, its result debt is sealed, or stress and warning paths cease overlapping.
creatureHabitatEnvelopes.questStateDelta: Cause branch, acoustic lead, structural scar, and remaining population persist.

creatureHabitatEnvelopes.anchorBehavior: Eleven cuffs open outward around one cold human center; twelve fixed sleeves connect to six seal pairs.
creatureHabitatEnvelopes.sustenance: Discarded paid breaths and acknowledged vent labor; it may repossess air only from a recorded unpaid shift debtor.
creatureHabitatEnvelopes.propagation: none; pooled breath changes pressure but never creates another Union.
creatureHabitatEnvelopes.cessation: Manual shutdown vents all paid breath to the cold center and closes intake sleeves in safe sequence.
creatureHabitatEnvelopes.questStateDelta: Sleeve availability, paid seals, heat-zone debt, and collective refusal persist.

creatureHabitatEnvelopes.anchorBehavior: Six legs remain outside the inhabited tie-in; four measured loop shadows terminate at witness posts, not destinations.
creatureHabitatEnvelopes.sustenance: Reachable return-route debt as authored; water output is treated and measured by the utility rather than consumed directly.
creatureHabitatEnvelopes.cessation: White-wind shutdown, exhausted route-debt input, or manual six-leg isolation.
creatureHabitatEnvelopes.questStateDelta: Leg states, loop coefficients, baffle condition, yield, and brine waste persist.

creatureHabitatEnvelopes.anchorBehavior: Each remains shadow-tethered to the unique Fleet and one bollard claim; it may carry load inland only along that tether.
creatureHabitatEnvelopes.sustenance: Unheard separable landing claims carried within the Fleet's existing collective shadow.
creatureHabitatEnvelopes.propagation: At most one bounded appendage appears per separable bollard petition; it cannot reproduce or become a ship.
creatureHabitatEnvelopes.cessation: Petition is heard, claim is rebound into the Fleet, direct light breaks the tether, or the two-tide operation ends.
creatureHabitatEnvelopes.questStateDelta: Delegate count returns to zero at cessation; heard-claim records and pile loads persist.
